text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as organisers of nationwide protests.
The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as participants of nationwide protests.
The nationwide protests took place in various Russian cities on 5 May 2018.
The nationwide protests on 5 May 2018 took place before Vladimir Putin's inauguration for the fourth presidential term.
The applicants raised other complaints under the provisions of the Convention, in addition to their complaint about disproportionate measures.
